title: 534. Convex Polygon

examples.explanation: A unit square: every consecutive turn bends the same way.
The last vertex dents inward, so one turn bends the opposite way from the rest.

hints: The sign of the cross product of each pair of consecutive edges tells you which way the boundary turns.
Straight (collinear) joints carry no turn information and can be skipped; everything else must agree in sign.
